title: Diseased (status group)
html:
Diseased is a status group. Diseases are often mundane in nature and can be cured on their own, or with the help of various potions and healing abilities.

Removal

The following items remove all conditions in this status group:

  • Potion of Vitality
  • Jhannyl's Gloves

The following spells/actions remove all conditions in this status group:

  • Lay on Hands: Cure
  • Lesser Restoration
  • Heal

Immunity

The following spells/actions grant immunity to all conditions in this status group:

  • Feign Death
  • Heroes' Feast

The following passive features grant immunity to all conditions in this status group:

  •  Divine Health
  •  Nature's Ward
  •  Purity of Body

List of conditions in Diseased

Condition Effects
Contagion Poisoned
  • Has  Disadvantage on  Attack Rolls and Checks.
  • Each turn, it must succeed on a  Saving Throw, or the poison will advance in stage. On 3 successes, it recovers. On 3 failures, it contracts the disease corresponding to the variant of the spell Contagion that was cast.
Crawling Gnaw
  • Target is inflicted with zombie mucus. If the affected entity dies before the infection wears off, it will temporarily rise as a Newborn Zombie.
  • Newborn Zombies are statistically the same as the Summoned Zombie, except that they only have 10 Hit Points, and they have the condition Newborn Zombie, causing them to take 1⁠⁠Necrotic damage per turn.
  • Newborn Zombies will follow the original Summoned Zombie.
Feverish
  • Increasingly feverish.  Disadvantage on  Ability Checks and  Saving Throws using Strength.
  • When the duration ends, make a  DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw. Failing will inflict the condition  Filth Fever.
Filth Fever
  • Crushed by fever.  Disadvantage on  Attack Rolls, and  Ability Checks and  Saving Throws using Strength.
  • When the duration ends, make a  DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw. Failing will re-inflict the Filth Fever condition.
  • Duration: 25 turns
Flesh Rot
  • Flesh is decaying.
  •  Disadvantage on  Ability Checks and  Saving Throws using Charisma.
  • Vulnerable to all damage.
  •  DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw to remove condition when the duration ends, otherwise it is reapplied.
Harm
  • Affected entity's maximum Hit Points have been reduced by the damage inflicted by the Harm spell
  • This condition is a Disease
Infected
  • Has  Disadvantage on Constitution Saving Throws, and Constitution is reduced by 1.
Infested
  • Crawling with tiny spiders that deal 1d4 Piercing damage and 1d4 Poison damage each turn.
  • When hit with a melee attack, the infestation spreads to the attacker. Upon death, the infestation spreads to all nearby creatures.
  • Removed by ⁠Fire or ⁠Acid damage.
  • Doesn't harm ettercaps or spiders.
Infested
  • Crawling with tiny spiders that deal 1d4 Piercing damage and 1d4 Necrotic damage each turn.
  • At the start of your turn you can make a  Dexterity Saving Throw to try and remove the infestation.
Rotting
  • Open wound is starting to rot.
  •  Disadvantage on  Ability Checks and  Saving Throws using Charisma.
  •  DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw to remove condition when the condition expires from duration. Failure will lead to you gaining  Flesh Rot.
Sea Plague
  • Beaded and adrip with thick oily sweat, the affected entity has  Disadvantage on  Ability Checks,  Saving Throws, and  Attack Rolls using  Strength.
Septic
  • Affected entity has its Constitution reduced by 1, and has  Disadvantage on Constitution  Saving Throws
Stricken With Blinding Sickness
  • Fingernails of searing pain dig into the affected entity's eyes. It has  Disadvantage on Wisdom Checks and  Saving Throws, and is also Blinded.
Stricken With Filth Fever
  • Beaded and adrip with thick oily sweat, the affected entity has  Disadvantage on Checks,  Saving Throws, and  Attack Rolls using Strength.
Stricken With Flesh Rot
  • Rotting in their own vat of stinking Skin, the affected entity has  Disadvantage on Charisma Checks and Vulnerability to all damage.
Stricken With Mindfire
  • Affected entity's brain is cooking in a stew of hot blood. It has  Disadvantage on Intelligence Checks and behaves as if  Confused during combat.
Stricken With Seizures
  • Involuntary convulsions shiver through the affected entity, giving it  Disadvantage on Ability Checks,  Saving Throws, and  Attack Rolls using Dexterity.
Stricken With Slimy Doom
  • Affected entity oozes waxy, globulous blood. It has  Disadvantage on Constitution Checks and  Saving Throws.
  • In addition, whenever it takes damage, it is Stunned until the end of its next turn.
